title: Midnight Rice Cakes
description: A classic Indian recipe made with steamed rice, eggs, and various spices. Perfect for a midnight snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: Indian
ingredients.notes: use fresh cumin for best flavor

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked rice and cumin. Mix well.
Add the chopped nuts and mix until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs until they are well beaten.
Add the eggs to the rice mixture and mix until everything is well combined.
Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Drop the rice mixture by spoonfuls into the pan and flatten slightly.
Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
